```{python}
from math import cos, pi, sin
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def regular_polygon(cx, cy, radius, vertices):
    points = []
    for index in range(vertices):
        angle = -pi / 2 + index * 2 * pi / vertices
        points.append((cx + radius * cos(angle), cy + radius * sin(angle)))
    return " ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x, y in points)


width = 1400
height = 1000
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Geometries d’entrada i paràmetres que controlen un buffer</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Quatre panells mostren el radi al voltant d’un punt, una línia i un polígon; l’aproximació circular amb un o quatre segments per quadrant; els extrems arrodonit, pla i quadrat; i les unions arrodonida, bisellada i en punta.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      .bg { fill: #f5f7f8; }",
    "      .card { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c8d3d9; stroke-width: 2; }",
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .title { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .subtitle { font-size: 25px; fill: #52616b; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .label { font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .body { font-size: 25px; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .buffer { fill: #7fc4de; fill-opacity: .5; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .buffer-stroke { fill: none; stroke: #7fc4de; stroke-opacity: .58; stroke-width: 72; }",
    "      .buffer-stroke-small { fill: none; stroke: #7fc4de; stroke-opacity: .58; stroke-width: 60; }",
    "      .source { fill: #d65f43; stroke: #8c3225; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .source-line { fill: none; stroke: #8c3225; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }",
    "      .ideal { fill: none; stroke: #84949c; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 7 6; }",
    "      .vertex { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 2; }",
    "      .measure { fill: none; stroke: #d65f43; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .endpoint { stroke: #84949c; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; }",
    "      .negative { fill: none; stroke: #d65f43; stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 7 5; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#d65f43"/>',
    '    </marker>',
    '  </defs>',
    f'  <rect class="bg" width="{width}" height="{height}"/>',
    '  <text x="35" y="47" class="title">Què determina la forma d’un buffer?</text>',
    '  <text x="35" y="80" class="subtitle">La distància defineix l’escala; la segmentació, els extrems i les unions defineixen l’aproximació geomètrica.</text>',

    # Geometry and radius panel.
    '  <rect x="35" y="105" width="650" height="385" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="65" y="146" class="heading">1. Geometria d’entrada i radi d</text>',
    '  <text x="143" y="184" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Punt</text>',
    '  <circle cx="143" cy="286" r="67" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="143" cy="286" r="9" class="source"/>',
    '  <line x1="143" y1="286" x2="207" y2="286" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="170" y="274" class="label">d</text>',
    '  <text x="347" y="184" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Línia</text>',
    '  <path d="M 285,315 C 320,235 385,235 430,300" class="buffer-stroke" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>',
    '  <path d="M 285,315 C 320,235 385,235 430,300" class="source-line"/>',
    '  <line x1="352" y1="256" x2="352" y2="220" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="364" y="238" class="label">d</text>',
    '  <text x="559" y="184" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Polígon</text>',
    '  <rect x="488" y="216" width="143" height="137" rx="38" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <rect x="520" y="248" width="79" height="73" class="source"/>',
    '  <rect x="543" y="269" width="33" height="31" class="negative"/>',
    '  <line x1="599" y1="284" x2="630" y2="284" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="607" y="272" class="label">+d</text>',
    '  <text x="559" y="298" text-anchor="middle" class="label">−d</text>',
    '  <text x="65" y="407" class="body">Punt: disc aproximat</text>',
    '  <text x="65" y="441" class="body">Línia: franja amb extrems</text>',
    '  <text x="65" y="475" class="body">Polígon: expansió (+d) o retracció (−d)</text>',

    # Segments per quadrant panel.
    '  <rect x="715" y="105" width="650" height="385" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="745" y="146" class="heading">2. Segments per quadrant</text>',
    '  <text x="745" y="177" class="subtitle">Mateix radi, aproximació diferent de la corba</text>',
    '  <circle cx="875" cy="295" r="82" class="ideal"/>',
    f'  <polygon points="{regular_polygon(875, 295, 82, 4)}" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="875" cy="295" r="8" class="source"/>',
    '  <circle cx="875" cy="213" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="957" cy="295" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="875" cy="377" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="793" cy="295" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <text x="875" y="414" text-anchor="middle" class="label">1 segment/quadrant</text>',
    '  <text x="875" y="445" text-anchor="middle" class="body">4 vèrtexs</text>',
    '  <circle cx="1195" cy="295" r="82" class="ideal"/>',
    f'  <polygon points="{regular_polygon(1195, 295, 82, 16)}" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="1195" cy="295" r="8" class="source"/>',
]

for index in range(16):
    angle = -pi / 2 + index * 2 * pi / 16
    x = 1195 + 82 * cos(angle)
    y = 295 + 82 * sin(angle)
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="4" class="vertex"/>')

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1195" y="414" text-anchor="middle" class="label">4 segments/quadrant</text>',
    '  <text x="1195" y="445" text-anchor="middle" class="body">16 vèrtexs</text>',

    # End caps panel.
    '  <rect x="35" y="520" width="650" height="425" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="65" y="562" class="heading">3. Extrems d’una línia</text>',
    '  <text x="65" y="593" class="subtitle">La línia original acaba a les guies discontínues</text>',
])

cap_rows = [
    (660, "Arrodonit", "round"),
    (770, "Pla", "butt"),
    (880, "Quadrat", "square"),
]
for y, label, cap in cap_rows:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <text x="65" y="{y + 8}" class="label">{label}</text>',
        f'  <line x1="270" y1="{y - 45}" x2="270" y2="{y + 45}" class="endpoint"/>',
        f'  <line x1="570" y1="{y - 45}" x2="570" y2="{y + 45}" class="endpoint"/>',
        f'  <path d="M 270,{y} L 570,{y}" class="buffer-stroke-small" stroke-linecap="{cap}"/>',
        f'  <path d="M 270,{y} L 570,{y}" class="source-line"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="270" cy="{y}" r="6" class="source"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="570" cy="{y}" r="6" class="source"/>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    # Joins panel.
    '  <rect x="715" y="520" width="650" height="425" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="745" y="562" class="heading">4. Unions entre segments</text>',
    '  <text x="745" y="593" class="subtitle">Els angles aguts amplifiquen la diferència</text>',
])

join_columns = [
    (825, "Arrodonida", "round", 4),
    (1040, "Bisellada", "bevel", 4),
    (1255, "En punta", "miter", 8),
]
for x, label, join, miter_limit in join_columns:
    path = f'M {x - 68},810 L {x},670 L {x + 68},810'
    svg.extend([
        f'  <path d="{path}" class="buffer-stroke-small" stroke-linecap="butt" stroke-linejoin="{join}" stroke-miterlimit="{miter_limit}"/>',
        f'  <path d="{path}" class="source-line"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x}" y="867" text-anchor="middle" class="label">{label}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1040" y="914" text-anchor="middle" class="body">El límit de punta restringeix prolongacions extremes.</text>',
    '  <text x="700" y="982" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">Només la configuració arrodonida aproxima literalment tots els punts situats a una distància màxima d.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/buffer-parameters.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
